title: The commodity currencies (AUD, NZD, CAD, ZAR) as a lead for spot gold

rule.cc: equal-weight mean of log returns of AUD/USD, NZD/USD, 1/USDCAD, 1/USDZAR
rule.dxy: ICE DXY on folded daily closes
rule.residual: e = c - alpha - beta x d, OLS on the 52 weeks before
rule.entry: next gold daily open; T1/T2 held 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20); T3 held 20 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: dollar-neutral commodity-currency week beyond 1 sd: gold the same way for the next week (primary)
raw commodity-currency week (against the USD) beyond 1 sd: gold the same way for the next week
dollar-neutral commodity-currency 4 weeks beyond 1 sd: gold the same way for the next 20 candles
